plugin.name: shared-edges
plugin._long: Dragging the edge two tiled windows share makes one grow as the other shrinks.

option.name: enabled
option._long: Whether dragging the edge between tiled windows resizes both. If not, only the dragged window is resized, and it stops being tiled.

option.name: tolerance
option._long: How many pixels apart two windows' edges may be and still count as one shared edge.

option.name: min_size
option._long: How many pixels wide or high a window may be made by dragging a shared edge, whatever the window itself allows.
